mines.mine_notes: royalty: 0.5% NSR retained on AngloGold Ashanti's (AGA) Arthur Gold Project near Beatty, Nevada (Silicon + Merlin gold deposits). On Jul 23, 2025 Altius sold 1.0% of its 1.5% NSR to Franco-Nevada, retaining 0.5%; royalty-lands arbitration concluded Aug 14, 2025. Development stage: Inferred Resource 12.91 Moz Au (391.14 Mt at 1.03 g/t Au) plus 3.4 Moz Indicated (121.56 Mt at 0.87 g/t) at Silicon. Post-FY2025 (Feb 2026), AGA declared a Probable Reserve of 4.9 Moz Au (88 Mt at 1.75 g/t) + 7.8 Moz Ag (88 Mt at 2.76 g/t) with AISC ~US$954/oz. PFS Technical Report Summary expected Q1 2026, then a feasibility study. Attributable ounces not disclosed (royaltyco, pre-production); ownership_pct shown is the NSR royalty rate. This is Altius's only precious-metals royalty/stream; see company notes for excluded non-precious segments.

notes: Diversified royalty/streamer (not a pure precious-metals royaltyco); fiscal year ended Dec 31, 2025, all amounts CAD. This entry covers ONLY Altius's precious-metals royalty: the 0.5% NSR on the Arthur Gold Project (Nevada). All other segments are EXCLUDED from the mines list: Chapada copper stream (3.7% Cu, Lundin Mining; ~C$21.5M revenue), IOC 7% gross overriding royalty on iron ore (~C$6.3M), six potash royalties (Rocanville, Cory, Allan, Patience Lake, Esterhazy, Vanscoy), Voisey's Bay 0.3% net value royalty (Ni-Cu-Co; ~C$1.7M), Gunnison copper royalty, Curipamba 2% NSR copper-zinc-precious metals (Ecuador, under construction), Kami 3% gross sales royalty iron ore (development), lithium royalties (Grota do Cirilo; Tres Quebradas via Lithium Royalty Corp acquisition closed Mar 6, 2026), ARR renewable electricity royalties (~C$13.4M), and the Genesee thermal coal royalty (Alberta; revenue ceased after 2023 when the operator converted the plant to natural gas). FY2025: attributable royalty revenue C$69.9M; adjusted EBITDA C$45.8M; net earnings C$299.4M (C$6.45/share), boosted by the gain on the Arthur royalty sale; dividends paid C$16.121M; 46,285,577 shares outstanding at Dec 31, 2025 (55,915,754 after the LRC acquisition). No producing gold/silver royalties, so attributable production is null. Head office: 2nd Floor, 38 Duffy Place, St. John's, NL, Canada A1B 4M5 (registered office Calgary, Alberta). Listed on TSX as ALS since Jan 15, 2007 (also OTCQX: ATUSF). Report: 2025 Annual Information Form dated Mar 10, 2026.
